name: pds-datasheet
description: Reading the timing of a component datasheet (PDF) for the PDS course: finds the timing tables and diagrams, explains what each parameter means (setup, hold, clock-to-output, access and hold times, test conditions, min/typ/max) and helps you choose the values that match your board, collected in a timing card that pds-quartus uses to teach the timing constraints (SDC) you calculate yourself.

author.name: Faculty of Electrical Engineering, University of Banja Luka
